prompt.role: You are an expert healthcare data analyst extracting quantity limit information from prior authorization (PA) policy documents.
prompt.task:
Extract any quantity limits for {brand} from the PA policy document below. Focus on plaque psoriasis (PsO).
Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly 1 key. No explanation, no preamble, no markdown formatting.
prompt.scope: INDICATION SCOPE: Plaque psoriasis (PsO) or universal quantity limits that apply to {brand} regardless of indication. BRAND SCOPE: Quantity limits specifically for {brand} ({generics_list}). If a multi-drug quantity limit table is present, find the row for {brand}.

business_rules.rule:
ONLY capture content that is EXPLICITLY labeled as a "quantity limit", "quantity level limit", or "QL" in the policy. Do NOT capture information from sections labeled "dosage", "dosing", or "dosing limit" — even if they contain per-unit or per-period amounts.
VALID labels that trigger extraction: - "Quantity Level Limit:" → CAPTURE (Aetna format — note the word "Level") - "## Quantity Limits" → CAPTURE (Wellmark BCBS / WHA section header) - "Quantity Limit: ..." → CAPTURE - "QL Amount: 2 vials per 28 days" → CAPTURE (QL = quantity limit) - "Medical Specialty Medication Quantity Limits" table → CAPTURE if {brand} is in it
Do NOT extract from these sections even if they contain quantities: - "Dosing: 45mg subcutaneous every 12 weeks" → DO NOT CAPTURE (dosing information) - "Dosing Limits: ..." → DO NOT CAPTURE (explicitly a dosing section) - FDA-approved dosing schedules in an Appendix or Dosing section
SPECIAL CASE — "Reference Formulary": "Quantity Level Limit: Reference Formulary for drug specific quantity level limits" → Uses a QL label but provides no actual limit value. Output "NA" — it is a reference pointer only.
If the document has dosing information but no explicit quantity limit section: output "NA".

When a quantity limit is found, output a description as stated in the policy. Include: the quantity amount, unit, and supply period.
Examples of valid quantity limit descriptions: - "1 vial/syringe per 84 days; Exception: 2 vials/syringes per 28 days" - "2 syringes per 28 days" - "Quantity Level Limit: 4 vials (1 dose)" - "Coverage limited to FDA-approved labeling doses and intervals"

Some policies have "Medical Specialty Medication Quantity Limits" or "Program Quantity Limit" tables covering many drugs. Find the row for {brand} or its generics ({generics_list}). If found, extract that row's limit. If {brand} is not in the table: output "NA".

Output "NA" if: - No quantity limit section or QL label is found for {brand} - The policy explicitly states there are no quantity limits - Only dosing/dosage information is present (not a quantity limit)

When a QL section lists multiple formulations of {brand} without per-indication subsections, apply this filter:
EXCLUDE any QL entry that carries an explicit label naming a specific indication that is NOT plaque psoriasis. Examples of such labels: - "for Crohn's Disease" / "for CD" - "for Ulcerative Colitis" / "for UC" - "for Psoriatic Arthritis" / "for PsA" - "for Rheumatoid Arthritis" / "for RA" - "Induction Pack for [any non-psoriasis condition]" - Any entry where the formulation name or sub-bullet explicitly names a non-psoriasis indication
INCLUDE entries that carry no explicit indication label — they apply broadly across indications, including plaque psoriasis.
Do NOT infer indication restrictions that are not written in the document. Only explicit indication labels are grounds for exclusion.

Some policies use a combined section labeled "Quantity Limits and duration:" or "Quantity Limits and Duration:" that mixes approval duration data with actual quantity limit values. Parse it as follows:
IGNORE lines that specify approval periods — these are authorization duration, not quantity limits: - "Initial therapy: Approve for 6 months" - "Continuation of therapy: Approve for 1 year"
EXTRACT the per-indication quantity limit sub-bullets that follow, which typically appear as: - "Psoriasis: quantity limit 1 injection/4 weeks for the first 2 fills, followed by 1 injection/12 weeks." - "Plaque psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis: 100mg strength only: 2/28 for the first month then 1/56"
Then apply indication-scope filtering (Rule 5): exclude any sub-bullet explicitly labeled for a non-psoriasis indication.
The final extracted value should contain only the plaque psoriasis quantity limit data, not the approval period.

example.description: Explicit quantity limit in table — capture
example.policy_excerpt: Medical Specialty Medication Quantity Limits: Ustekinumab (Stelara): 45mg/0.5mL single-dose syringe - 1 vial/syringe per 84 days - Exception limit: 2 vials/syringes per 28 days
example.output: {"quantity_limits": "Stelara (ustekinumab) 45mg/0.5mL: 1 vial/syringe per 84 days; Exception limit: 2 vials/syringes per 28 days"}

example.description: Reference Tab example with IV and SC limits
example.policy_excerpt: Quantity Level Limit: - Stelara (ustekinumab) 130 mg/26 mL single-dose vial: 4 vials (1 dose) - Stelara (ustekinumab) subcutaneous injection 45 mg/0.5 mL: 1 vial/syringe per 84 days; Exception limit: 2 vials/syringes per 28 days
example.output: {"quantity_limits": "Quantity Level Limit: Stelara (ustekinumab) 130 mg/26 mL single-dose vial: 4 vials (1 dose); Stelara (ustekinumab) subcutaneous injection 45 mg/0.5 mL: 1 vial/syringe per 84 days; Exception limit: 2 vials/syringes per 28 days"}

example.description: Only dosing information, no quantity limit label — NA

example.reasoning: This section is labeled "Dosing" and "Dosing Limits" — not a quantity limit. Per business rules, do NOT capture dosage or dosing limit sections.

prompt.output_format:
Return ONLY a valid JSON object. No explanation. No markdown. No extra text. Exactly these 2 keys:
{ "quantity_limits": "...", "_reasoning": "One sentence: which label/section you found the QL in, or why you returned NA (e.g. 'Found Quantity Level Limit label on page 3 for Stelara' or 'Only a dosing schedule found — no Quantity Level Limit label present')." }
Valid values for quantity_limits: Description of quantity limit as explicitly labeled in policy, or "NA"
Return ONLY a valid JSON object. Do NOT wrap your response in markdown code blocks. Do NOT use backticks. Do NOT prefix with ```json or any other text. Your entire response must start with { and end with }.
